reason: No cited evidence is provided to support any of the key premises. The specific claims about phase precipitation, film formation, kinetic transitions, and quantitative performance targets are entirely unsupported by prior reported results.
premises: SPS at 1000 °C induces diffusion-driven precipitation of specific barrier oxides (AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, FeTiO3) from a BCC MgAlTiVFeCo solid solution
These precipitated oxides form a continuous passive film
The continuous oxide film retards Cl⁻ penetration and establishes parabolic oxidation kinetics
This leads to enhanced corrosion and oxidation resistance compared to lower-temperature sintering
The specific target values (~96.7% density, ~1235.5 HV hardness) are achievable and indicative of superior performance
